fullContentHtml:
UPCISB UP Cooperative Bank Various Post Admit Card 2026 – Complete Details

U.P. Co-operative Institutional Service Board, Lucknow (UPCISB) has officially issued the Admit Card for the Combined Co-operative Banking, Non-Banking, and Technical Services Examination 2026. The examination is scheduled to be held on 21 September 2026 across various examination centres in Uttar Pradesh.

Important Dates

  • Online Application Start: 25 April 2026
  • Registration Last Date: 15 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date: 15 May 2026
  • Admit Card Release Date: 15 September 2026
  • Exam Date: 21 September 2026

Application Fee Details

  • General / OBC Candidates: ₹500/-
  • SC / ST Candidates: ₹250/-
  • Divyangjan (PH) Candidates: ₹250/-

Vacancy Distribution (Total: 2085 Posts)

  • Assistant / Cashier (Banking & Clerical Staff): 887 Posts
  • Junior Manager: 486 Posts
  • Junior Engineer (Civil / Electrical): 238 Posts
  • Assistant Manager (General & Computer): 120 Posts
  • Manager: 65 Posts
  • Assistant Engineer (Civil / Electrical): 34 Posts
  • Assistant Accountant: 28 Posts
  • Stenographer, Typist & Other Posts: 87 Posts

How to Download UPCISB Admit Card 2026

  1. Click on the direct Download Admit Card link given in the Important Links section below.
  2. You will be redirected to the official IBPS examination portal for UPCISB.
  3. Enter your Registration Number / Roll Number and Password / Date of Birth.
  4. Enter the Captcha code shown on the login screen and click on Submit.
  5. Your UPCISB Admit Card will appear on the screen.
  6. Download the PDF admit card and take a clear printout. Carry this admit card along with a valid original photo ID (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID) to the exam centre.

Important Links

  • Download Admit Card (Direct Link)
  • Candidate Login Portal
  • Official Website (UPCISB)

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

When was UPCISB Admit Card 2026 released?

The UPCISB Admit Card 2026 was officially released on 15 September 2026.

What is the UPCISB exam date for 2085 various posts?

The examination is scheduled to be conducted on 21 September 2026.

What details are required to download the UPCISB Admit Card?

Candidates need their Registration Number / Roll Number and Password / Date of Birth to log in and download the hall ticket.

What is the official website of UPCISB?

The official portal of UP Co-operative Institutional Service Board is https://upcib.org.in.
